prompt: Sarah is configuring a Pure-FTPd server and wants to set up a maximum number of simultaneous clients that can connect to her FTP server. Which command line option should she use when starting the Pure-FTPd server to enforce this limitation?
explanation: The `-c` option (`--maxclientsnumber`) sets the maximum number of simultaneous clients. `-C` (`--maxclientsperip`) limits connections per IP, not the total.
